policy: Conservatively reserve EVERY previously registered/scored original evaluation task across all branches. Before any new original validation, compare exact source hashes and prove ZERO overlap with cumulative ledger, not only ancestors of current Git branch.
chronology_provenance: Earlier cohorts P21-P27 are preserved in historical order; later first-score runs ordered by GitHub Actions creation timestamp. Two P29 first studies ran independently and overlapped.

corrections.claim: P29 first has 48 wholly unseen eval files
corrections.correct: 23/48 reused from earlier P19 study; only 25/48 new relative to prior cross-branch tests. P29 one correct id 0692e18c not reused in P19 and retains independent source proof.

corrections.claim: P30 first has 48 wholly unseen eval files
corrections.correct: 16/48 reused from P19, and 19/48 reused from parallel P29-B, with 10 in BOTH reuse groups. Therefore 25/48 distinct previous repeats and only 23/48 first-use relative to all earlier runs. P30 had no additional exact answers and zero new crop-composed submissions.

corrections.claim: After P30 there are 24 untouched original evaluation files
corrections.correct: 11 unused once P19, both parallel P29 studies and P30 are included in one global ledger.

distinction: A first-run result can be valid as a source-executed performance measurement even if its 'newly unseen cohort' claim fails provenance. Do not relabel it a clean blind validation or close Q3/Q6/Q7.
heldout_policy: Quarantine 11 not-registered original public evaluation file IDs. Treat as potentially contaminated until a complete GitHub, Notion and manual-exposure history audit confirms no previous inspection. Prefer a genuinely new external semantic family and frozen independent source instead of consuming the last public ARC items.
scope_limit: 389/400 is the union of the twelve source-locked manifests in this ledger. The remaining 11 are NOT REGISTERED in these manifests; historical unmanifested manual inspection, alternate clones, or other branches are not proven absent. Never describe these 11 as guaranteed untouched without an independent complete-history audit.
